title: Choose the visual world for UsagePass
question: The roll assigned Riso Registration. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Riso Registration
options.lineage: risograph-printed zines and indie studio print runs
options.thesis: A license is a two-ink print: out of register while pending, snapping into register the moment PayPal captures.
options.viewport: Left rail (Works, Requests, Licenses); centre: the brand's sentence parsed into itemised terms; right: the license proof, its pink and blue plates offset until payment.
options.risk: Turns into zine costume if halftone and misregistration spread beyond the one license moment.

raised.raise: Every AI term carries its rate-card clause in a shoulder margin beside it, so the citation is read, not hidden in a tooltip.
Fluorescent pink is reserved for the one live state (the license being paid for); nothing else may use it.
Blue ink appears only on things you can press; disabled actions lose the ink entirely.
Every amount is set in tabular figures in one column, so $310.00 and its split line up to the cent.
License states are one fixed ordered line (Quoted, Paid, Active, Paid out, or Revoked) shown the same way on every screen.

options.label: End Credits
options.lineage: film end-credit rolls and record-sleeve liner notes
options.thesis: Every license ends in its credits: who made the work, their role, and what they were paid.
options.viewport: Dark title-card shell; the license sits centre stage and the collaborators' credit block rolls up with each payout as it lands.
options.risk: The most familiar move for creative tools, and a dark cinematic shell can feel heavy for a daily working screen.

options.label: Ticket Wallet
options.thesis: Each license is a coupon book: rights tear off as coupons, and a refund stamps VOID instead of disappearing.
options.viewport: Top bar; the request becomes a coupon book with one coupon per right, a carbon total box, and a red VOID stamp for revoked licenses.
options.case: Fuses cleanly on clarity (validated, used, void maps exactly onto license states) but brands and creators do not see themselves in airline ephemera.
options.risk: Reads as travel nostalgia if the coupon chrome outgrows the data.

options.label: Warm Consumer App
options.thesis: Soft cards, plain labels, one action color.
options.viewport: Stacked cards in one column with a bottom bar.
options.case: Clear but anonymous: no creator identifies with it, and it is no clearer than the assigned world.
options.kept: Action-only colour: ink appears only where something can be pressed.

options.label: Lexicon Shoulder
options.thesis: Entries ranked by apparatus, colour quarantined in plates.
options.viewport: Text column with guide words and a shoulder index.
options.case: Too bookish for brands buying ad rights; loses on both axes.
options.kept: Shoulder-margin citations: each AI term shows its rate-card clause beside it.
options.risk: Reads as a dictionary, not a checkout.

options.label: Orienteering Map
options.thesis: A fixed colour language with one ink reserved for the active leg.
options.viewport: Map ground with a purple course over it.
options.case: No one in this audience runs orienteering; the map metaphor confuses checkout.
options.kept: One reserved ink for the single live state.
options.risk: Pure costume on a licensing screen.

options.label: Transit Diagram
options.thesis: Journeys drawn as coloured lines and interchanges.
options.case: A five-step flow does not need a network map; audience does not see itself here.
options.kept: A fixed, ordered state line shown identically everywhere.

options.label: Datamatics Field
options.thesis: Barcode fields and monospace numerics in pure black and white.
options.viewport: Black field of bars with numeric margins.
options.case: Cold and unreadable for creators and small brands.
options.kept: Tabular numerics: every amount aligned to the cent.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean creator-marketplace dashboard, the way Cruva or Aspire ship it, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Top nav, a request form on the left, a quote card and status badges on the right.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the platforms we are positioned against.
